story.iWant: content recommendations based on my reading patterns
story.soThat: I discover relevant content I might miss
story.tasks: 1. Create UserActivityTracker service to monitor user interactions (AC: 1, 2) 2. Develop RecommendationEngine with simple heuristic algorithms (AC: 2, 3) 3. Integrate recommendations into dashboard UI components (AC: 1, 4, 5) 4. **Testing** - Create comprehensive test suite for recommendation system 5. **Documentation** - Add user guide for recommendation features

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Given I've been using Megalith for >1 week, When I view any dashboard tab, Then I see a "Recommended for You" section 2. And recommendations include: sources I read most, categories I engage with, similar content to what I've clicked 3. And recommendations update daily based on last 30 days of activity 4. And I can dismiss recommendations 5. And I can provide feedback (helpful/not helpful)

doc.title: Epic Breakdown
doc.snippet: Track user interactions: clicks, time spent, sources viewed. Store in data/users/{user_id}/activity_log.json. Simple recommendation algorithm: 1. Top 5 sources by click count, 2. Top 3 categories by engagement, 3. Content similar to recently clicked items (title similarity)

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: File-based JSON storage for user activity and recommendations. Integration with existing dashboard component system. Performance: Must handle user activity logging without blocking dashboard rendering

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: Personalized content discovery engine that learns from user behavior patterns

constraints.constraint: Must preserve <30-minute source integration capability [Source: docs/architecture.md#Decision-Summary]

Non-blocking background jobs to preserve dashboard performance
Per-user data isolation with appropriate access controls

interface.name: UserActivityTracker
interface.signature: track_interaction(user_id: str, action: str, content_id: str, metadata: dict)

interface.name: ActivityEvent

tests.standards: Follow existing pytest patterns with >70% coverage target. Test files in Tests/recommendations/ with comprehensive coverage of user activity tracking, recommendation algorithms, dashboard integration, and performance. Use mocking for external dependencies.

test.idea: Test UserActivityTracker accuracy with various interaction types
Test recommendation algorithms produce expected top sources/categories
Test dashboard component displays recommendations correctly
Test dismiss functionality removes recommendations from display
Test feedback mechanism stores and utilizes user feedback
Test daily background job refresh without blocking
